ayahs.arabicText: طٰهٰۚ
ayahs.translation: Ta, Ha.

ayahs.arabicText: مَاۤ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَیْكَ الْقُرْاٰنَ لِتَشْقٰۤىۙ
ayahs.translation: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَنْ یَّخْشٰىۙ
ayahs.translation: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -

ayahs.arabicText: تَنْزِیْلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ الْاَرْضَ وَ السَّمٰوٰتِ الْعُلٰىؕ
ayahs.translation: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,

ayahs.arabicText: اَلرَّحْمٰنُ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوٰى
ayahs.translation: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.

ayahs.arabicText: لَهٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا وَ مَا تَحْتَ الثَّرٰى
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ تَجْهَرْ بِالْقَوْلِ فَاِنَّهٗ یَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَ اَخْفٰى
ayahs.translation: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ؕ لَهُ الْاَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنٰى
ayahs.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هَلْ اَتٰىكَ حَدِیْثُ مُوْسٰىۘ
ayahs.translation: And has the story of Moses reached you? -

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ رَاٰ نَارًا فَقَالَ لِاَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوْۤا اِنِّیْۤ اٰنَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّیْۤ اٰتِیْكُمْ مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ اَوْ اَجِدُ عَلَى النَّارِ هُدًى
ayahs.translation: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّاۤ اَتٰىهَا نُوْدِیَ یٰمُوْسٰىؕ
ayahs.translation: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْۤ اَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَیْكَ١ۚ اِنَّكَ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًىؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنَا اخْتَرْتُكَ فَاسْتَمِعْ لِمَا یُوْحٰى
ayahs.translation: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّنِیْۤ اَنَا اللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِیْ١ۙ وَ اَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ لِذِكْرِیْ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ اٰتِیَةٌ اَكَادُ اُخْفِیْهَا لِتُجْزٰى كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعٰى
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا یَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَنْ لَّا یُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَ اتَّبَعَ هَوٰىهُ فَتَرْدٰى
ayahs.translation: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا تِلْكَ بِیَمِیْنِكَ یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ هِیَ عَصَایَ١ۚ اَتَوَكَّؤُا عَلَیْهَا وَ اَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلٰى غَنَمِیْ وَ لِیَ فِیْهَا مَاٰرِبُ اُخْرٰى
ayahs.translation: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اَلْقِهَا یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَلْقٰىهَا فَاِذَا هِیَ حَیَّةٌ تَسْعٰى
ayahs.translation: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَ لَا تَخَفْ١ٙ سَنُعِیْدُهَا سِیْرَتَهَا الْاُوْلٰى
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اضْمُمْ یَدَكَ اِلٰى جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَیْضَآءَ مِنْ غَیْرِ سُوْٓءٍ اٰیَةً اُخْرٰىۙ
ayahs.translation: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,

ayahs.arabicText: لِنُرِیَكَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِنَا الْكُبْرٰىۚ
ayahs.translation: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْهَبْ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰى۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِیْ صَدْرِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَسِّرْ لِیْۤ اَمْرِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: And ease for me my task

ayahs.arabicText: وَ احْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّنْ لِّسَانِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: And untie the knot from my tongue

ayahs.arabicText: یَفْقَهُوْا قَوْلِیْ۪
ayahs.translation: That they may understand my speech.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اجْعَلْ لِّیْ وَزِیْرًا مِّنْ اَهْلِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: And appoint for me a minister from my family -

ayahs.arabicText: هٰرُوْنَ اَخِیۙ
ayahs.translation: Aaron, my brother.

ayahs.arabicText: اشْدُدْ بِهٖۤ اَزْرِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: Increase through him my strength

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَشْرِكْهُ فِیْۤ اَمْرِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: And let him share my task

ayahs.arabicText: كَیْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِیْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: That we may exalt You much

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ نَذْكُرَكَ كَثِیْرًاؕ
ayahs.translation: And remember You much.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّكَ كُنْتَ بِنَا بَصِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ قَدْ اُوْتِیْتَ سُؤْلَكَ یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَیْكَ مَرَّةً اُخْرٰۤىۙ
ayahs.translation: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ اَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلٰۤى اُمِّكَ مَا یُوْحٰۤىۙ
ayahs.translation: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,

ayahs.arabicText: اَنِ اقْذِفِیْهِ فِی التَّابُوْتِ فَاقْذِفِیْهِ فِی الْیَمِّ فَلْیُلْقِهِ الْیَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ یَاْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّیْ وَ عَدُوٌّ لَّهٗ١ؕ وَ اَلْقَیْتُ عَلَیْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّیْ١ۚ۬ وَ لِتُصْنَعَ عَلٰى عَیْنِیْۘ
ayahs.translation: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ تَمْشِیْۤ اُخْتُكَ فَتَقُوْلُ هَلْ اَدُلُّكُمْ عَلٰى مَنْ یَّكْفُلُهٗ١ؕ فَرَجَعْنٰكَ اِلٰۤى اُمِّكَ كَیْ تَقَرَّ عَیْنُهَا وَ لَا تَحْزَنَ١ؕ۬ وَ قَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّیْنٰكَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَ فَتَنّٰكَ فُتُوْنًا١۫۬ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِیْنَ فِیْۤ اَهْلِ مَدْیَنَ١ۙ۬ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلٰى قَدَرٍ یّٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِیْۚ
ayahs.translation: And I produced you for Myself.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْهَبْ اَنْتَ وَ اَخُوْكَ بِاٰیٰتِیْ وَ لَا تَنِیَا فِیْ ذِكْرِیْۚ
ayahs.translation: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْهَبَاۤ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰىۚۖ
ayahs.translation: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

ayahs.arabicText: فَقُوْلَا لَهٗ قَوْلًا لَّیِّنًا لَّعَلَّهٗ یَتَذَكَّرُ اَوْ یَخْشٰى
ayahs.translation: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَا رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّنَا نَخَافُ اَنْ یَّفْرُطَ عَلَیْنَاۤ اَوْ اَنْ یَّطْغٰى
ayahs.translation: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَاۤ اِنَّنِیْ مَعَكُمَاۤ اَسْمَعُ وَ اَرٰى
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاْتِیٰهُ فَقُوْلَاۤ اِنَّا رَسُوْلَا رَبِّكَ فَاَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ١ۙ۬ وَ لَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ١ؕ قَدْ جِئْنٰكَ بِاٰیَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ١ؕ وَ السَّلٰمُ عَلٰى مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الْهُدٰى
ayahs.translation: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا قَدْ اُوْحِیَ اِلَیْنَاۤ اَنَّ الْعَذَابَ عَلٰى مَنْ كَذَّبَ وَ تَوَلّٰى
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَنْ رَّبُّكُمَا یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِیْۤ اَعْطٰى كُلَّ شَیْءٍ خَلْقَهٗ ثُمَّ هَدٰى
ayahs.translation: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الْقُرُوْنِ الْاُوْلٰى
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّیْ فِیْ كِتٰبٍ١ۚ لَا یَضِلُّ رَبِّیْ وَ لَا یَنْسَى٘
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَّ سَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِیْهَا سُبُلًا وَّ اَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً١ؕ فَاَخْرَجْنَا بِهٖۤ اَزْوَاجًا مِّنْ نَّبَاتٍ شَتّٰى
ayahs.translation: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.

ayahs.arabicText: كُلُوْا وَ ارْعَوْا اَنْعَامَكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّاُولِی النُّهٰى۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.

ayahs.arabicText: مِنْهَا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ وَ فِیْهَا نُعِیْدُكُمْ وَ مِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً اُخْرٰى
ayahs.translation: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرَیْنٰهُ اٰیٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَ اَبٰى
ayahs.translation: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ اَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَنَاْتِیَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِّثْلِهٖ فَاجْعَلْ بَیْنَنَا وَ بَیْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهٗ نَحْنُ وَ لَاۤ اَنْتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى
ayahs.translation: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ یَوْمُ الزِّیْنَةِ وَ اَنْ یُّحْشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًى
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَوَلّٰى فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَیْدَهٗ ثُمَّ اَتٰى
ayahs.translation: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُّوْسٰى وَیْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوْا عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا فَیُسْحِتَكُمْ بِعَذَابٍ١ۚ وَ قَدْ خَابَ مَنِ افْتَرٰى
ayahs.translation: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَنَازَعُوْۤا اَمْرَهُمْ بَیْنَهُمْ وَ اَسَرُّوا النَّجْوٰى
ayahs.translation: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اِنْ هٰذٰىنِ لَسٰحِرٰنِ یُرِیْدٰنِ اَنْ یُّخْرِجٰكُمْ مِّنْ اَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَ یَذْهَبَا بِطَرِیْقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلٰى
ayahs.translation: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَجْمِعُوْا كَیْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ائْتُوْا صَفًّا١ۚ وَ قَدْ اَفْلَحَ الْیَوْمَ مَنِ اسْتَعْلٰى
ayahs.translation: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰمُوْسٰۤى اِمَّاۤ اَنْ تُلْقِیَ وَ اِمَّاۤ اَنْ نَّكُوْنَ اَوَّلَ مَنْ اَلْقٰى
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ بَلْ اَلْقُوْا١ۚ فَاِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَ عِصِیُّهُمْ یُخَیَّلُ اِلَیْهِ مِنْ سِحْرِهِمْ اَنَّهَا تَسْعٰى
ayahs.translation: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَوْجَسَ فِیْ نَفْسِهٖ خِیْفَةً مُّوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْاَعْلٰى
ayahs.translation: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَلْقِ مَا فِیْ یَمِیْنِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوْا١ؕ اِنَّمَا صَنَعُوْا كَیْدُ سٰحِرٍ١ؕ وَ لَا یُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَیْثُ اَتٰى
ayahs.translation: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاُلْقِیَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هٰرُوْنَ وَ مُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اٰمَنْتُمْ لَهٗ قَبْلَ اَنْ اٰذَنَ لَكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِیْرُكُمُ الَّذِیْ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ١ۚ فَلَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَیْدِیَكُمْ وَ اَرْجُلَكُمْ مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَّ لَاُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِیْ جُذُوْعِ النَّخْلِ١٘ وَ لَتَعْلَمُنَّ اَیُّنَاۤ اَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَّ اَبْقٰى
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا لَنْ نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلٰى مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ الْبَیِّنٰتِ وَ الَّذِیْ فَطَرَنَا فَاقْضِ مَاۤ اَنْتَ قَاضٍ١ؕ اِنَّمَا تَقْضِیْ هٰذِهِ الْحَیٰوةَ الدُّنْیَاؕ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِیَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطٰیٰنَا وَ مَاۤ اَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَیْهِ مِنَ السِّحْرِ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ خَیْرٌ وَّ اَبْقٰى
ayahs.translation: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring."

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهٗ مَنْ یَّاْتِ رَبَّهٗ مُجْرِمًا فَاِنَّ لَهٗ جَهَنَّمَ١ؕ لَا یَمُوْتُ فِیْهَا وَ لَا یَحْیٰى
ayahs.translation: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ یَّاْتِهٖ مُؤْمِنًا قَدْ عَمِلَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجٰتُ الْعُلٰىۙ
ayahs.translation: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:

ayahs.arabicText: جَنّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِیْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَا١ؕ وَ ذٰلِكَ جَزٰٓؤُا مَنْ تَزَكّٰى۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلٰى مُوْسٰۤى١ۙ۬ اَنْ اَسْرِ بِعِبَادِیْ فَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِیْقًا فِی الْبَحْرِ یَبَسًا١ۙ لَّا تَخٰفُ دَرَكًا وَّ لَا تَخْشٰى
ayahs.translation: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُوْدِهٖ فَغَشِیَهُمْ مِّنَ الْیَمِّ مَا غَشِیَهُمْؕ
ayahs.translation: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهٗ وَ مَا هَدٰى
ayahs.translation: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].

ayahs.arabicText: یٰبَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ قَدْ اَنْجَیْنٰكُمْ مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَ وٰعَدْنٰكُمْ جَانِبَ الطُّوْرِ الْاَیْمَنَ وَ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَیْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَ السَّلْوٰى
ayahs.translation: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,

ayahs.arabicText: كُلُوْا مِنْ طَیِّبٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنٰكُمْ وَ لَا تَطْغَوْا فِیْهِ فَیَحِلَّ عَلَیْكُمْ غَضَبِیْ١ۚ وَ مَنْ یَّحْلِلْ عَلَیْهِ غَضَبِیْ فَقَدْ هَوٰى
ayahs.translation: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنِّیْ لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَنْ تَابَ وَ اٰمَنَ وَ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهْتَدٰى
ayahs.translation: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَعْجَلَكَ عَنْ قَوْمِكَ یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ هُمْ اُولَآءِ عَلٰۤى اَثَرِیْ وَ عَجِلْتُ اِلَیْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضٰى
ayahs.translation: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَاِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِكَ وَ اَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِیُّ
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray."

ayahs.arabicText: فَرَجَعَ مُوْسٰۤى اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖ غَضْبَانَ اَسِفًا١ۚ۬ قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اَلَمْ یَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا١ؕ۬ اَفَطَالَ عَلَیْكُمُ الْعَهْدُ اَمْ اَرَدْتُّمْ اَنْ یَّحِلَّ عَلَیْكُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ فَاَخْلَفْتُمْ مَّوْعِدِیْ
ayahs.translation: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا مَاۤ اَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَ لٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَاۤ اَوْزَارًا مِّنْ زِیْنَةِ الْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنٰهَا فَكَذٰلِكَ اَلْقَى السَّامِرِیُّۙ
ayahs.translation: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهٗ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوْا هٰذَاۤ اِلٰهُكُمْ وَ اِلٰهُ مُوْسٰى١۬ فَنَسِیَؕ
ayahs.translation: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَا یَرَوْنَ اَلَّا یَرْجِعُ اِلَیْهِمْ قَوْلًا١ۙ۬ وَّ لَا یَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّا وَّ لَا نَفْعًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هٰرُوْنُ مِنْ قَبْلُ یٰقَوْمِ اِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهٖ١ۚ وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحْمٰنُ فَاتَّبِعُوْنِیْ وَ اَطِیْعُوْۤا اَمْرِیْ
ayahs.translation: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا لَنْ نَّبْرَحَ عَلَیْهِ عٰكِفِیْنَ حَتّٰى یَرْجِعَ اِلَیْنَا مُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰهٰرُوْنُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اِذْ رَاَیْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوْۤاۙ
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ١ؕ اَفَعَصَیْتَ اَمْرِیْ
ayahs.translation: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَاْخُذْ بِلِحْیَتِیْ وَ لَا بِرَاْسِیْ١ۚ اِنِّیْ خَشِیْتُ اَنْ تَقُوْلَ فَرَّقْتَ بَیْنَ بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ وَ لَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِیْ
ayahs.translation: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.' "

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ یٰسَامِرِیُّ
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ یَبْصُرُوْا بِهٖ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةً مِّنْ اَثَرِ الرَّسُوْلِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَ كَذٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِیْ نَفْسِیْ
ayahs.translation: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ فَاِنَّ لَكَ فِی الْحَیٰوةِ اَنْ تَقُوْلَ لَا مِسَاسَ١۪ وَ اِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّنْ تُخْلَفَهٗ١ۚ وَ انْظُرْ اِلٰۤى اِلٰهِكَ الَّذِیْ ظَلْتَ عَلَیْهِ عَاكِفًا١ؕ لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهٗ ثُمَّ لَنَنْسِفَنَّهٗ فِی الْیَمِّ نَسْفًا
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَاۤ اِلٰهُكُمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِیْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ؕ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ عِلْمًا
ayahs.translation: Your god is only Allah, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."

ayahs.arabicText: كَذٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَیْكَ مِنْ اَنْۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ١ۚ وَ قَدْ اٰتَیْنٰكَ مِنْ لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًاۖۚ
ayahs.translation: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an.

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ اَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَاِنَّهٗ یَحْمِلُ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ وِزْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,

ayahs.arabicText: خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهِ١ؕ وَ سَآءَ لَهُمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ حِمْلًاۙ
ayahs.translation: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -

ayahs.arabicText: یَّوْمَ یُنْفَخُ فِی الصُّوْرِ وَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَ یَوْمَئِذٍ زُرْقًاۚۖ
ayahs.translation: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.

ayahs.arabicText: یَّتَخَافَتُوْنَ بَیْنَهُمْ اِنْ لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا عَشْرًا
ayahs.translation: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."

ayahs.arabicText: نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا یَقُوْلُوْنَ اِذْ یَقُوْلُ اَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِیْقَةً اِنْ لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا یَوْمًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَسْئَلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ یَنْسِفُهَا رَبِّیْ نَسْفًاۙ
ayahs.translation: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.

ayahs.arabicText: فَیَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًاۙ
ayahs.translation: And He will leave the earth a level plain;

ayahs.arabicText: لَّا تَرٰى فِیْهَا عِوَجًا وَّ لَاۤ اَمْتًاؕ
ayahs.translation: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَئِذٍ یَّتَّبِعُوْنَ الدَّاعِیَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهٗ١ۚ وَ خَشَعَتِ الْاَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ اِلَّا هَمْسًا
ayahs.translation: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ اِلَّا مَنْ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَ رَضِیَ لَهٗ قَوْلًا
ayahs.translation: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.

ayahs.arabicText: یَعْلَمُ مَا بَیْنَ اَیْدِیْهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَ لَا یُحِیْطُوْنَ بِهٖ عِلْمًا
ayahs.translation: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ عَنَتِ الْوُجُوْهُ لِلْحَیِّ الْقَیُّوْمِ١ؕ وَ قَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا
ayahs.translation: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ یَّعْمَلْ مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ هُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا یَخٰفُ ظُلْمًا وَّ لَا هَضْمًا
ayahs.translation: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِیًّا وَّ صَرَّفْنَا فِیْهِ مِنَ الْوَعِیْدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَتَّقُوْنَ اَوْ یُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا
ayahs.translation: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ١ۚ وَ لَا تَعْجَلْ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ یُّقْضٰۤى اِلَیْكَ وَحْیُهٗ١٘ وَ قُلْ رَّبِّ زِدْنِیْ عِلْمًا
ayahs.translation: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ عَهِدْنَاۤ اِلٰۤى اٰدَمَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَنَسِیَ وَ لَمْ نَجِدْ لَهٗ عَزْمًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوْۤا اِلَّاۤ اِبْلِیْسَ١ؕ اَبٰى
ayahs.translation: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.

ayahs.arabicText: فَقُلْنَا یٰۤاٰدَمُ اِنَّ هٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَ لِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا یُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقٰى
ayahs.translation: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ لَكَ اَلَّا تَجُوْعَ فِیْهَا وَ لَا تَعْرٰىۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا فِیْهَا وَ لَا تَضْحٰى
ayahs.translation: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."

ayahs.arabicText: فَوَسْوَسَ اِلَیْهِ الشَّیْطٰنُ قَالَ یٰۤاٰدَمُ هَلْ اَدُلُّكَ عَلٰى شَجَرَةِ الْخُلْدِ وَ مُلْكٍ لَّا یَبْلٰى
ayahs.translation: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْاٰتُهُمَا وَ طَفِقَا یَخْصِفٰنِ عَلَیْهِمَا مِنْ وَّرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ١٘ وَ عَصٰۤى اٰدَمُ رَبَّهٗ فَغَوٰى۪ۖ
ayahs.translation: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اجْتَبٰهُ رَبُّهٗ فَتَابَ عَلَیْهِ وَ هَدٰى
ayahs.translation: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِیْعًۢا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ١ۚ فَاِمَّا یَاْتِیَنَّكُمْ مِّنِّیْ هُدًى١ۙ۬ فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَایَ فَلَا یَضِلُّ وَ لَا یَشْقٰى
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ اَعْرَضَ عَنْ ذِكْرِیْ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ مَعِیْشَةً ضَنْكًا وَّ نَحْشُرُهٗ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ اَعْمٰى
ayahs.translation: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِیْۤ اَعْمٰى وَ قَدْ كُنْتُ بَصِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اَتَتْكَ اٰیٰتُنَا فَنَسِیْتَهَا١ۚ وَ كَذٰلِكَ الْیَوْمَ تُنْسٰى
ayahs.translation: [Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِیْ مَنْ اَسْرَفَ وَ لَمْ یُؤْمِنْۢ بِاٰیٰتِ رَبِّهٖ١ؕ وَ لَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَشَدُّ وَ اَبْقٰى
ayahs.translation: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَمْ یَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ یَمْشُوْنَ فِیْ مَسٰكِنِهِمْ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّاُولِی النُّهٰى۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ لَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَّ اَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّىؕ
ayahs.translation: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].

ayahs.arabicText: فَاصْبِرْ عَلٰى مَا یَقُوْلُوْنَ وَ سَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوْعِ الشَّمْسِ وَ قَبْلَ غُرُوْبِهَا١ۚ وَ مِنْ اٰنَآئِ الَّیْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَ اَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضٰى
ayahs.translation: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَیْنَیْكَ اِلٰى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهٖۤ اَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا١ۙ۬ لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِیْهِ١ؕ وَ رِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَیْرٌ وَّ اَبْقٰى
ayahs.translation: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اْمُرْ اَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَ اصْطَبِرْ عَلَیْهَا١ؕ لَا نَسْئَلُكَ رِزْقًا١ؕ نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ١ؕ وَ الْعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوٰى
ayahs.translation: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا لَوْ لَا یَاْتِیْنَا بِاٰیَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖ١ؕ اَوَ لَمْ تَاْتِهِمْ بَیِّنَةُ مَا فِی الصُّحُفِ الْاُوْلٰى
ayahs.translation: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ اَنَّاۤ اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِهٖ لَقَالُوْا رَبَّنَا لَوْ لَاۤ اَرْسَلْتَ اِلَیْنَا رَسُوْلًا فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰیٰتِكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ نَّذِلَّ وَ نَخْزٰى
ayahs.translation: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوْا١ۚ فَسَتَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ اَصْحٰبُ الصِّرَاطِ السَّوِیِّ وَ مَنِ اهْتَدٰى۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
